role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 凭借灵巧的手指和灵活的舌头，朗戈随时都能驱散敌友，用恰到好处的乐曲为他的团队提供伤害，治疗，或加速。
hero_summary_en: With his slick-strumming fingers and sticky-whip tongue, Largo is always ready to grant his team damage, healing, or speed and dispel friends or foes using just the right lick.

abilities.name: largo_catchy_lick
abilities.description_zh:
朗戈用他的舌头舔舐目标单位，把它拉回一小段距离，施加弱驱散，如果是敌人还会造成伤害。

击杀目标或驱散目标的效果后都会使朗戈暂时获得生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 可以舔舐神符，将其牵引。
notes_en: Can lick runes to pull them.

abilities.name: largo_frogstomp
abilities.description_zh: 朗戈把小青蛙扔到一片区域。他们每%stomp_interval%秒都会践踏地面，造成伤害和短暂眩晕并且区域内敌人的移动速度会被减缓。
abilities.description_en: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every %stomp_interval% second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.

abilities.name: largo_croak_of_genius
abilities.description_zh:
朗戈对一名友方英雄弹奏一首小调。英雄的技能和物品拥有的魔法消耗降低，并且造成伤害后会回响，接下来%damage_duration%秒内再次造成原本伤害的一定百分比。

只要作用下的英雄消耗了魔法，本增益的剩余持续时间都会减少%duration_reduction%秒。朗戈身上的持续时间不会减少。
abilities.description_en:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following %damage_duration% seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by %duration_reduction%s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
notes_zh: 只适用于可受到技能增强作用的伤害来源。
只会在来源和目标相距%max_distance%以内时施加伤害。
notes_en: Only applies to damage sources affected by spell amplification.
Only applies to damage where the source and target are within %max_distance% units of each other.

abilities.name: largo_encore
abilities.description_zh: 朗戈对自身或队友施加的增益效果会延长持续时间。
abilities.description_en: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.

shard_loc.en: Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff.If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.
shard_loc.zh: 只要朗戈对友方英雄施加单位目标技能的增益效果，他也会获得该增益。只要朗戈对自身施加，该增益也会施加给指向性技能的施法距离内最近的友方英雄。

abilities.name: largo_amphibian_rhapsody
abilities.description_zh:
朗戈准备好弹奏乐曲。他被缴械，而他的技能栏切换为3个乐曲技能，每个都有不同的效果。乐曲只有弹在节拍上才会生效。

每次成功弹奏他都会获得一层律动的叠加效果。每层叠加效果都会对他提供额外护甲，并且降低每首乐曲的魔法消耗，但是他只要错过一次节拍就会失去一层叠加效果。叠加效果在朗戈的乐曲结束后还会粘滞一小段时间。
abilities.description_en:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
notes_zh: 这个模式下可以使用物品。
notes_en: Items can be used while in this mode.

scepter_loc.en: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.
scepter_loc.zh: 朗戈在每次节拍时可以弹奏两首乐曲。

special_values.name: song_cost_reduction_per_stack_tooltip
special_values.heading_loc: SONG MANA COST REDUCTION PER STACK:

abilities.name: largo_song_fight_song
abilities.description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成%burst_damage%点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。
abilities.description_en: Largo plays a song that deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.

scepter_loc.en: Deals additional %damage_per_stack% magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.
scepter_loc.zh: 这首乐曲用于两首共弹时每层律动都会额外造成%damage_per_stack%点魔法伤害。

abilities.name: largo_song_double_time
abilities.description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会提升附近友方单位的移动速度，还有短时间的减速抗性。
abilities.description_en: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.

abilities.name: largo_song_good_vibrations
abilities.description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会治疗附近友方英雄。
abilities.description_en: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.
